questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion in a conditional clause to express a strong hypothetical scenario?
options: If she had known the truth, she would have left immediately.
Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.
She would have left immediately if she had known the truth.
She left immediately because she had known the truth.
questions.answer: Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence best captures the idea that 'the most important factor in success is hard work'?
options: Hard work is what makes success possible.
The factor that success is based on is hard work.
What matters most for success is hard work.
Success is achieved through hard work alone.
questions.answer: What matters most for success is hard work.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario where a request is made?
options: She wishes she could go to the party with me.
She wishes I would go to the party with her.
She wishes that I go to the party with her.
She wishes I was invited to the party with her.
questions.answer: She wishes I would go to the party with her.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis effectively to maintain a formal register while omitting redundant information?
options: She apologised for being late and said she would be there next time.
She apologised for being late; she would be there next time.
She apologised for being late, and she promised to arrive on time.
She apologised, saying she had been delayed and would make it up to me.
questions.answer: She apologised for being late; she would be there next time.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of a complex structure with a relative clause and a participle phrase to describe an action that occurred after another event?
options: After finishing her homework, she went out to meet her friends, who were already waiting.
Having finished her homework, she went out to meet her friends who were waiting.
She went out to meet her friends after she had finished her homework, who were waiting.
She went out to meet her friends who were waiting, having finished her homework.
questions.answer: After finishing her homework, she went out to meet her friends, who were already waiting.
